name: microshort2-integration-tests
description: Black-box integration tests for the microshort 2 stack

scripts.reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build --wait
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build --wait && vitest run
scripts.test:e2e:rate: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.test.override.yml down -v && docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.test.override.yml up -d --build --wait && vitest run -c vitest.rate.config.js
